<!--
Work PR → develop: the title is the squash commit summary, so it starts with
ADD: / FIX: / REF: / DEL: / DOCS: / UPT: (see .agents/skills/commit/SKILL.md).
"pr-guard" checks it.

Release PR develop → main: title "Release <game> v<x.y.z>", list the PRs it
brings in under "What and why", delete the other sections. After the merge,
tag main with <game>-v<x.y.z> to build and publish the release.

Delete what doesn't apply.
-->

## What and why

<!-- One or two sentences. If the reason isn't visible in the code (a DS hardware
quirk, an emulator difference, a licence decision), write it here. -->

Closes #

## Kind

- [ ] ✨ New game, feature, scene, demo or tool (`ADD:`)
- [ ] 🐛 Bug fix (`FIX:`)
- [ ] 🧹 Refactor, no visible change (`REF:`)
- [ ] 🗑️ Removal (`DEL:`)
- [ ] 📝 Docs or agent config only (`DOCS:`)
- [ ] 📦 Version bump: toolchain digest, image, pinned action (`UPT:`)

## How it was verified

<!-- Say where: headless DeSmuME, melonDS, real hardware. They differ, so name what
you did not try as well. Attach screenshots for visual changes. -->

## Checklist

- [ ] `./build.sh` has no warnings (`./build.sh demos` too if shared code changed)
- [ ] Smoke-tested the touched scenes or demos in the headless emulator
- [ ] Two clean builds give the same SHA-256 (toolchain or asset pipeline changes)
- [ ] English docs and their `-KO` twins changed together
- [ ] No ROMs, saves or build output in the diff
- [ ] Generated files in sync (`python3 scripts/sync_agents.py --check`, `python3 scripts/mklogo.py`)

## Licensing

<!-- Delete this section if no files, assets or libraries were added. -->

- [ ] New source/build files start with the SPDX header
- [ ] New assets are generated by code in `tools/` (or CC0 with a source URL) and listed in `ASSETS.md` and `ASSETS-KO.md`
- [ ] A new library in the ROM comes with `THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES`, `licenses/` and in-game credits
- [ ] No third-party game names, characters or logos; no emulator or platform names in ROM content
